sources.title: Meituan backend interview note containing the exact linked-list-add prompt
Deterministic Java validation for reverse-order linked-list addition

claims.text: The repository source states two non-empty linked lists represent non-negative integers, digits are stored in reverse order, and the output is the list representing their sum; it does not preserve a concrete Java node class or an in-place requirement.
Under the explicit one-decimal-digit-per-node representation used by the candidate, the executable fixture validates normal addition, zero, unequal lengths, carry chains and a final extra carry node.
